prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the prior ShiftPress mockup into the final DARK-ONLY Rose theme. Preserve its excellent functional layout, content order and straight-on desktop application client-area framing. No light mode anywhere. Output 1484x1060 pixels or the same aspect and framing as the input. This image is the measured reference for a real Tkinter Windows app.

Replace every pale or white surface with deliberate dark surfaces: window #15131B, main panels #211D29, recessed inputs #191620, borders #514558, primary text #F8F3F8, supporting text #C0ADC3. Header band #22182A, title pure white, subtitle muted rose #E8A4CC. Rose/pink #E59AC8 is the key color: filled primary Print button with very dark #251522 text; selected radio/checkbox rose; outlined Setup button rose; Reset run rose. Night panel header #252339 and title #B7B5ED; Day panel header #35272B and title #E9B77E. All text must remain clearly legible, flat color fills, fine borders; no gradient, no glows, no shadows, no ornamental imagery.

Header: left "ShiftPress" and "Schedules, ready for the next shift." Right place a native dropdown labeled "Theme" showing "Rose" with chevron, then outlined "How to use", then small "v3.0.0". Theme menu has only Rose and Midnight (not open).
Keep setup strip: "Print setup" (sentence case, not all caps); groups Night templates / Templates › Night, Day templates / Templates › Day, Printer / Microsoft Print to PDF; Setup… button.
Keep "Prepare print run", supporting instruction, and Reset run aligned right.
Keep Night schedule and Day schedule peer cards with checked include controls, selected Single date vs Date range native radios side by side, date input 09/05/2026 and 09/06/2026, and Selected · 1 document.
Keep full-width Print scope: 2 schedules selected, two exact job lines, printer name.
Bottom: "Preflight runs when you select Print." and large pink "Print 2 schedules" button.
Make this feel like a beautifully crafted professional Windows utility with rich plum-black surfaces and precisely balanced pink accents. No white panels, no light mode, no dashboard navigation, no new functionality beyond the theme selector.
purpose: Dark-only Rose design reference requested by the user; native controls remain semantic.
